nodes.label: authorizeDrDrill safety interlock
nodes.rationale: target-guard.ts single gate before any scenario. Stricter than production preflight authorizeApply: APP_ENV=production has NO override flag at all (chaos tool has no legitimate prod use case), and default-deny on DB host (unrecognized hostname refused, not assumed safe). --confirm-non-production typo-catcher must match APP_ENV. Widening the local-host allowlist is a reviewed code change, never a runtime flag.

nodes.label: DR scenario catalog (safe/full tiers)
nodes.rationale: Each ScenarioDefinition has explicit implemented/simulated/cross-verified disclosure — provider-outage-sso-discovery, pool-saturation, postgres-disconnect (client-level simulated), worker-interruption (real SIGTERM + advisory lock), provider-outage-email, backup-restore-drill (full tier). Safe tier runs in CI; overall verdict is tri-state (pass/fail/incomplete) so a skip is never mistaken for a pass.

nodes.label: RTO/RPO evidence + nightly backup (dinkes-prod)
nodes.rationale: Measured live 2026-07-24: pg_dump -Fc backup ~1.7s/708KB, restore ~6.3s, RPO=0 at dump instant. Coolify had 0 scheduled backups (unbounded RPO); nightly host cron (admin1 30 2 * * *, sdb1, 14-day retention, gzip -t integrity gate) now bounds RPO to <=24h. Offsite R2 copy still open (needs a private bucket, not the public media bucket).
